pages.title: What does it produce?
pages.text: Each operation chooses one allowed resource-bee type and resolves that bee's real advanced-beehive product. Most use a typed configurable comb; bees with independent items, such as Ghostly, Milky and Powdery, keep their own real comb.

pages.title: Typed comb output
pages.text: Most Myriad output is a PB configurable comb carrying bee_type data, which normal stacking, pipes and AE2 preserve. A bee with an independent comb identifies itself by the item and is never replaced with a blank configurable comb.

pages.title: Survival acquisition
pages.text: The default example converts a vanilla bee when it is right-clicked with a stick, while valid parent bees can also breed the result. A modpack may change the item, chance, and parents. Fishing and nest spawning are disabled by default; check Gameplay Settings → Bee Acquisition for the current world rules.

pages.title: Control candidates
pages.text: Gameplay Settings → Myriad Creations Filter offers Disabled, Blacklist, and Whitelist modes. Blacklist is convenient for excluding a few resources. Whitelist permits only listed resources, and an empty whitelist leaves no candidate. Use localized search instead of typing registry IDs when possible.

pages.title: Comb blocks and type data
pages.text: The Comb Block upgrade prefers compact output and uses Productive Bees' matching real block for independent combs. Centrifuges process it directly. Configurable combs preserve bee_type data; a blank one without that data cannot select a recipe.

pages.title: Visuals do not change yield
pages.text: Rainbow, particles, glow, and colors affect only the local display. Production chance, candidate lists, bee attributes, and acquisition rules remain controlled by the world or server.
